test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In what duration will a sum of Rs. 2,100 fetch a simple interest of Rs. 1,050 at 10% per annum rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,100

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹1,050

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T) / 100

Where, T = Time in years

**Calculations:**

1050 = (2100 × 10 × T) / 100

⇒ 1050 = 210 × T

⇒ T = 1050 / 210

⇒ T = 5 years

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
